record_notes.netnet_use_evidence: Directory inclusion alone does not establish NetNet use. Preserve recorded registry/local provenance and status; an empty consumer_policies list means not recorded, not unused. No exhaustive consumer list or exact-token relationship is inferred.

The public app registry and local definitions identify it as V1 superseded by V2 0xa84efC3136BF1Bb89ade9E5BE6Ab32cb1A04f08D on 2026-08-27. Both addresses are retained; current status is publisher/local-reported, not live verified.

The app registry identifies the same router address as V2 and identifies a never-granted V1 predecessor. Do not equate vault operation or a public registry address with router activation.

known_discrepancies.topic: LP Zap deployment versus public app availability
known_discrepancies.detail: The September 16 indexed creation corroborates the LP Zap address. On September 18 the app registry still labels it PLACEHOLDER and its Add liquidity panel gates the one-transaction route pending levy exemption, offering direct Uniswap provision instead. PLACEHOLDER does not mean undeployed; registry promotion and current on-chain exemption are not independently established.

known_discrepancies.detail: Predict's observed binary market displays combined Treasury and Sleeve and has a depositor-funded House Vault. Do not import backing-per-NET brackets, parimutuel rules or no-house-side assumptions from the older NAV Pool proposal. Series outcome identities do not establish resolver authority, exact tie/void rules or audited vault solvency.

known_discrepancies.topic: THE BOOK house versus Predict House Vault
known_discrepancies.detail: September 20 targeted THE BOOK review: SportsBookDesk holds wsNET and published rules identify the house as the RWA Sleeve, never Treasury. Its house pot is not the depositor-funded USDG Predict House Vault. Launch language, publisher HUMAN-VERIFIED labels and successful indexed creation metadata do not verify source equivalence, current authority, balances or solvency; no fixed-block direct live verification was performed.
